key_insight: EHR-Complex is a new benchmark that tests clinical agents on realistic, interactive EHR reasoning instead of simplified static database queries.
clinical_relevance: It better reflects how clinicians and health systems may need to query complex longitudinal records for both individual patients and populations.
method: Built on MIMIC-IV with 365K patients, 31 tables, and 500M+ records.
Includes about 52K tasks across six clinical intents.
Requires interactive SQL or Python execution in a sandboxed environment.
evidence_signal: In evaluation, the best model reached only 62.3% exact-match accuracy, and pass@4 consistency fell below 50% for nearly all models.
watch_item: Performance on this benchmark may not directly translate to safe real-world clinical use because the tasks still run in a controlled sandbox and depend heavily on query/program execution quality.
paper_title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
